text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This brings back memories of when I was
still
acting...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I once performed in a show that hardly
garnered
any applause when it ended.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The audience was utterly unimpressed
with my
acting that day...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The result of today's race makes me feel
just like I
did then... I wasn't able to
entertain anyone!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But I don't have time to mope around.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My dream—my miracle—is still in the
making,
after all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My dream—my miracle—is still in the
making,
after all!

choice_data_list_en: I believe in you, and so does everyone else.
Everyone and I believe in you.

Everyone and I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I did... I did hear them! They were all
calling my
name!
choice_data_list: 声援が聞こえなかったか？
声援が聞こえなかった？

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And as long as I have even one person
who
believes in me, I can run to the ends
of the earth!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And thank you for believing in me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll carve today's loss into my heart and
use it as
motivation to stand in the
starting gate once
more!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll win my next race and show everyone
how much
I appreciate them!
